note: Reel 2 How it sees. Voice only (am_adam), no music. 'at' = start second of each line, one line per scene (plan.md). 'title' = short title shown under that scene. Facts only from facts.md; no numbers, no handles. Closing differs from reel 1 and reel 3.

lines.text: Meet SytronANPR: Automatic Number Plate Recognition.
lines.title: Meet SytronANPR

lines.text: Vehicles pass in a blink, and nobody can write down every plate.
lines.title: Too many plates, too little time

lines.text: A camera looks at the road, and the system reads.
lines.title: The camera looks, the system reads

lines.text: Single line or double line, Indian plates are read as they arrive, in real time.
lines.title: One line or two, read as it arrives

lines.text: Several plates in one camera view are each found and read.
lines.title: Many plates, one view

lines.text: Day, night, rain or glare, it keeps on reading.
lines.title: Day, night, rain, glare: still reading

lines.text: It knows what is passing: car, bus, truck, two-wheeler or auto.
lines.title: It knows what is passing

lines.text: Radar adds the speed of each vehicle.
lines.title: Radar adds the speed

lines.text: For every vehicle it saves the plate image, the car image, the date, the time and the speed.
lines.title: Every vehicle, saved as one record

lines.text: It sees. It reads. It remembers. www.sytronsoft.com
lines.title: It sees. It reads. It remembers.
